title: Normalized homogeneous Hom coordinates for the condensed bar
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on $\operatorname{Profinite}_u$ and $G$ a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group of size $u$. Use internal modules and continuous generalized $G$-actions as in [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data] and [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], in the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $F$ be any specified internal-function presentation, $B$ its inhomogeneous bar diagram, $V$ a normalized invariants functor, and $a$ its invariant augmentation [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Let $E$ be a normalized homogeneous resolution [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution]. For every equivariant module $I$ (without injectivity), every $n\geq0$ and profinite $S$, there is an additive equivalence $V_A^n(I)(S)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{G}(P_n\otimes_A A[S],I)$, fixed on generalized generator pairs by $f(s;g_0,\ldots,g_n)=g_0 c(s;g_0^{-1}g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1}^{-1}g_n)$. Here $A[S]$ is the free internal module [def-sfb-condensed-free-module-adjunction], and tensor is [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor]. The equivalence commutes with all profinite restrictions, equivariant coefficient maps and the alternating differentials. It sends the given invariant augmentation to the constant homogeneous family. In degree minus one there is an additive equivalence $I^G(S)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_G(A[S]_{\mathrm{triv}},I)$; under both equivalences the augmented map is precomposition by the tensored homogeneous augmentation. No injective or exactness assertion is included.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-condensed-free-linearization-tensor] for the actual free adjunction and relative tensor: maps from P_n tensor A[S] are natural generalized values on generator pairs. Equivariance of their extensions is detected on generators by [lem-sfb-condensed-group-algebra-exact-forgetful]. No claim that sections are globally free is made.

Use [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data] to regard an inhomogeneous section as a natural family c_T(s;b_1,...,b_n). Assign (s;g_0,...,g_n) the value g_0 c_T(s;g_0^{-1}g_1,...,g_{n-1}^{-1}g_n). Simultaneous multiplication by u fixes all adjacent ratios and multiplies the output by u. The inverse evaluates a homogeneous map on (s;1,b_1,b_1b_2,...,b_1...b_n). Cumulative products telescope to g_0^{-1}g_i; equivariance cancels g_0. Thus both composites are identities. Addition, restrictions, and equivariant postcomposition commute with these formulas.

Precompose by the deletion boundary of [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution]. On a prefix tuple, deleting the first coordinate gives the first action face, deleting an interior coordinate merges the two adjacent ratios in their given order, and deleting the last drops the last ratio. These are exactly the BarDiagram face fields from [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Summing with the alternating signs gives the differential identity. Generator detection from [lem-sfb-condensed-free-linearization-tensor] proves the internal map equality.

Combine the free adjunction of [def-sfb-condensed-free-module-adjunction] with the normalized invariants adjunction recorded in [def-sfb-condensed-action-module] (in its same-universe specialization in [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]). This gives an additive equivalence between invariant sections over S and equivariant maps from trivial A[S]. Such a map sends [s] to the restriction of the invariant section. The tensored augmentation in [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution] sends each homogeneous generator paired with [s] to [s]. Its transpose therefore gives the constant homogeneous family. The normalization of Augmentation in [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data] identifies that family with the prescribed augmentation; generator detection proves the augmentation square and its evaluation formula.
